Name: Tapper and Mushroom Crops
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Tapper & Mushroom Crops[/b] adds 11 new growable crops which harvest existing vanilla Stardew Valley items.

The five tapper-product crops are designed as small tapped trunks and behave like trellis crops, so the farmer cannot walk through them.

All crop and seed sprite edits in this mod were created by KhaStark using vanilla Stardew Valley artwork as the base/source.

[b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Maple Syrup crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Oak Resin crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pine Tar crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sap crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mystic Syrup crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Common Mushroom crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Morel crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Chanterelle crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Red Mushroom crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Purple Mushroom crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Magma Cap crop[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]All crops regrow after harvest.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Seeds are sold by Pierre after progression-based unlocks.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]One configuration option can disable normal season restrictions if you want every crop to grow in every season.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Uses the existing vanilla harvest items instead of adding duplicate syrup, resin, sap, or mushroom objects.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]English is bundled by default, with an i18n structure ready for translations.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Growth and regrowth[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Maple Syrup — 15 days to mature, then every 9 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Oak Resin — 15 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pine Tar — 15 days to mature, then every 5 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sap — 20 days to mature, then every 1 day.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mystic Syrup — 20 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Common Mushroom — 15 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Morel — 15 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Chanterelle — 15 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Red Mushroom — 15 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Purple Mushroom — 15 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Magma Cap — 20 days to mature, then every 7 days.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Default seasons[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sap, Pine Tar, Maple Syrup, Oak Resin, and Common Mushroom — Spring, Summer, and Fall.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mystic Syrup and Purple Mushroom — all seasons.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Morel — Spring.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Chanterelle — Fall.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Red Mushroom — Summer and Fall.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Magma Cap — all seasons, but outdoors it can only be planted on Ginger Island. [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
The [b]Use season restrictions[/b] config option is enabled by default. Disable it if you want all 11 crops to grow in every season. Magma Cap's Ginger Island/outdoor restriction is not removed by this setting.

[b]Pierre seed unlocks[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sap Seeds — Foraging level 2.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Common Mushroom Seeds — Foraging level 3.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Maple Syrup Seeds — Foraging level 4.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Oak Resin Seeds — Foraging level 4.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pine Tar Seeds — Foraging level 4.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Morel Seeds — Foraging level 5.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Chanterelle Seeds — Foraging level 7.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Red Mushroom Seeds — reach Mine level 80.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Purple Mushroom Seeds — reach Mine level 120.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mystic Syrup Seeds — unlock Foraging Mastery.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Magma Cap Seeds — visit Ginger Island.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.3.0 or newer[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Content Patcher 2.8.1+[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Credits[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]KhaStark — mod design, crop/seed artwork edits, data, balancing, and packaging.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]ConcernedApe / Stardew Valley — original vanilla artwork used as the base/source for the crop and seed sprite edits, and the vanilla harvest items used by the mod.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pathoschild — SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/font][/*]
[/list]
